"""Read the already reopened pristine workspace again; no open/run/save/close calls."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import uuid

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = base.parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('runner', base/'run.py')
runner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(runner)
park = base/'park-20261013T141636Z-0077e72a'
restore = base/'restore-20261013T142451Z-324b5b1a'
before = runner.load(park/'parameter-snapshot.json')
initial = runner.parameter_snapshot(runner.load(restore/'restored.json')['nodes'])
assert set(before) == set(initial)
differences = []
for key in before:
    assert len(before[key]) == len(initial[key])
    for index, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(before[key], initial[key])):
        changed = [field for field in a if a[field] != b[field]]
        assert changed in ([], ['variables'])
        if changed:
            assert [v for v in a['variables'] if not v.startswith('Data:')] == b['variables']
            differences.append(dict(path=key, occurrence=index, before=a['variables'], after=b['variables']))
assert len(differences) == 117
script = base/'inspect-restored.ps1'
text = (base/'restore.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert text.count('[A01Inspector]::Bind($true,$pristine)') == 1
text = text.replace('[A01Inspector]::Bind($true,$pristine)', '[A01Inspector]::Bind($false,$pristine)')
with script.open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as stream:
    stream.write(text)
out = base/('inspect-restoration-'+datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8])
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
ps = Path('C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe')
env = {k.upper():v for k,v in os.environ.items()}
env['PSMODULEPATH'] = str(ps.parent/'Modules')
command = [str(ps), '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-File', str(script), '-OutputDirectory', str(out), '-Profile', 'read-only-restoration-check']
state = dict(started_utc=runner.now(), command=command, analysis_calls=0, status='starting',
             helper_script_sha256=runner.digest(script))
def save_status():
    (out/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
save_status()
print('OUTPUT', out, flush=True)
with (out/'stdout.log').open('xb') as stdout, (out/'stderr.log').open('xb') as stderr:
    proc = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr, env=env, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    state.update(helper_pid=proc.pid, status='running')
    save_status()
    try:
        state.update(exit_code=proc.wait(timeout=120), status='returned')
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        proc.kill(); proc.wait()
        state['status'] = 'timeout_helper_only_terminated_application_not_restarted'
state['finished_utc'] = runner.now()
save_status()
print((out/'stdout.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='replace'))
print((out/'stderr.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig', errors='replace'))
if state.get('exit_code') != 0:
    raise SystemExit(1)
reinspection = runner.load(out/'restored.json')
assert reinspection['pristine_sha256'] == runner.digest(runner.PRISTINE) == 'ead90a212c786eff0cfa782dab47dbfe14c421b3f43b32c573bb990cb8348877'
observed = runner.parameter_snapshot(reinspection['nodes'])
assert observed == before, 'Full ordered rich parameter snapshots still differ'
record = dict(schema_version=1, recorded_utc=runner.now(), plan_sha256=runner.PLAN_SHA,
    classification='restoration_verified_by_read_only_reinspection',
    parameter_paths_verified=len(before), parameter_occurrences_verified=sum(map(len,before.values())),
    all_parameter_values_expressions_shapes_already_equal_on_initial_restore=True,
    initial_metadata_difference_count=len(differences), initial_metadata_differences=differences,
    explanation='The initial restore had identical values, expressions, shapes and methods, but 117 PartParam variable lists lacked their lazily materialized Data descriptor. The inspector evaluates GetValue after enumerating that list. A second read of the same already-open pristine workspace matches all original fields and all ordered occurrences exactly. No analysis, reopen, save, or close was performed for this inspection.',
    reinspection_directory=str(out.relative_to(root)), additional_analysis_calls=0,
    full_rich_snapshot_equal=True, user_application_left_running=True,
    pristine_sha256=reinspection['pristine_sha256'],
    original_restore_status_retained=True,
    source_snapshots={str(path.relative_to(root)):dict(sha256=runner.digest(path),utf8_source=path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8'))
                      for path in [script,Path(__file__).resolve()]},
    artifact_sha256={str(path.relative_to(root)):runner.digest(path) for path in [
        park/'before.json', park/'parameter-snapshot.json', restore/'restored.json', restore/'status.json',
        out/'restored.json',out/'status.json',out/'stdout.log',out/'stderr.log',out/'application.json']})
summary = root/'validation/am-pm-datapoints-zero-restoration-20261013.json'
runner.save_new(summary, record)
runner.save_new(restore/'validated.json', dict(validated_utc=record['recorded_utc'], directory=str(restore.relative_to(root)),
    parameters_verified=record['parameter_occurrences_verified'], analysis_calls=0,
    followup_read_only_verification=dict(path=str(summary.relative_to(root)),sha256=runner.digest(summary)),
    artifact_sha256={name:runner.digest(restore/name) for name in [
        'restored.json','application.json','source-snapshot.json','stdout.log','stderr.log','status.json']}))
print('Restoration fully verified:', record['parameter_occurrences_verified'], 'ordered occurrences; unchanged acceptance; 0 additional analyses.')
